function.name: dev_loop
function.description: Orchestrates concurrent terminal worker agents in isolated git worktrees across multiple harnesses (OpenAI, Claude Code, Gemini/Cloud Code) to execute planning, editing, testing, and two-sided verification.

objective.description: High-level engineering task or goal to implement.

base_branch.description: Base git branch to branch worktrees from and reconcile into.

terminal_layout.description: Terminal session layout manager for worker execution.

worktree_dir.description: Dedicated parent directory for worktree instances (must be gitignored).

domain.description: Domain or subsystem responsibility (e.g., backend, frontend, qa, security).

worker_id.description: Unique worker identifier (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores).

harness.description: Agent harness CLI driving the lane.

worktree.description: Relative directory path for the isolated git worktree.

command.description: Instruction, prompt, or command for the harness worker.

test_cmd.description: Automated verification test command executed in the worktree.

reconcile_and_clean.description: Whether to perform automated pre-merge verification, atomic merge, and worktree cleanup.
